description: This PHP source file defines the class 'DocumentsParseRule' which extends 'BaseRule' and provides methods to parse and transform panel data structures, primarily related to document metadata, for the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM platform.

classes.name: DocumentsParseRule
classes.description: A rule class for parsing document-related panels in the CRM's UI forms, transforming specific fields based on matching patterns.

methods.name: preParse
methods.description: Transforms panel data fields based on certain pattern matches before rendering, modifying related document IDs, revision info, user date formats, and category fields.

methods.name: parsePanels
methods.description: Cleans up panel data fields related to document files and revisions by resetting certain fields to empty strings.
